89ff23c1c8e6591cf4260ccfaef23adeccff72a6: A resort on a human scale, Arêches-Beaufort prioritises the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than impressive figures. Its 50 km of pistes are ideal for a 3 to 4 day stay, especially for families or skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. The technical terrain is king at Arêches-Beaufort: with 7 black runs and 14 red runs on offer, confident skiers will find plenty to challenge them. Off-piste and freeride are practised here in often excellent conditions thanks to the altitude and the exposure of the slopes. The altitude of Arêches-Beaufort (1,080 m at the bottom, 2,300 m at the top) allows it to keep a decent snow cover in midwinter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is best to check conditions before finalising a booking. The 39€ day lift pass places Arêches-Beaufort among the mid-range resorts on price: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and facilities justifies this price for most skiers. In short: Arêches-Beaufort keeps its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
